title: Spotting the NSA by where number theory PhDs cluster around Fort Meade
place_text: Fort Meade, Maryland; Los Alamos, New Mexico

tellings.quote: you'd look at number theory PhDs and you'd ask what zip codes do number theory PhDs live in when they don't get an academic job that's visible and you find that they're clustered around Fort me.

plain: You can find hidden government science, the mathematician Eric Weinstein tells Michels, by asking where number theory PhDs live when they don't get a visible academic job, and the answer is that they cluster around Fort Meade, the Maryland base that is home to the NSA. He offers it as a method of his own, with Los Alamos as another such place, and it would mean secret work can be traced by where talent quietly disappears to.
